plan: Queue offlane as primary. It is Mr_Meat31's best role at 53.7% over 148 games (overall is 51.7%). Set support as secondary, not the other way around.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Murdock and Phase. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Mr_Meat31 wins about 4.4 and 4.4 more games per 100 on them.
Mr_Meat31's champion pool is 12+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Mr_Meat31 is at 777 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 867.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 is running hotter than the career line
insights.finding: The last 20 games are 70% against a 52% career. Whatever changed recently, keep it.
insights.receipt: 14/20 recent wins vs 51.7% over 1039 career games

insights.title: The tilt tax is real for Mr_Meat31
insights.finding: Right after a loss Mr_Meat31 wins 56%; right after a win, 69%. One cooldown break after losses is free VP.
insights.receipt: 5/9 after losses vs 9/13 after wins, last 23 games

insights.title: Murdock is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 159 games and Mr_Meat31 genuinely out-pilots the field on Murdock — about 4.4 more wins per 100 games than the average Murdock player. The hours show.

insights.title: Xeebs brings out Mr_Meat31's best
insights.finding: Mr_Meat31's record alongside Xeebs is 54% over 289 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: 1 pentakill in real 5v5s and a longest spree of 19 (plus 13 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Mr_Meat31 has receipts.
